CLASS cl_neutral_matrix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_left,
        key_id TYPE i,
        group_id TYPE i,
        amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
        day_value TYPE d,
        note_text TYPE c LENGTH 12,
      END OF ty_left.
    TYPES tt_left TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_left WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_right,
        key_id TYPE i,
        code_text TYPE c LENGTH 8,
        factor TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 3,
      END OF ty_right.
    TYPES tt_right TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_right WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_mix,
        key_id TYPE i,
        group_id TYPE i,
        amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
        day_value TYPE d,
        note_text TYPE c LENGTH 12,
        code_text TYPE c LENGTH 8,
        factor TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 3,
      END OF ty_mix.
    TYPES tt_mix TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mix WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_rank,
        key_id TYPE i,
        group_id TYPE i,
        amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
        rank_value TYPE i,
        dense_value TYPE i,
        row_value TYPE i,
        note_text TYPE c LENGTH 12,
      END OF ty_rank.
    TYPES tt_rank TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_rank WITH EMPTY KEY.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      mix_rows
      IMPORTING VALUE(it_left) TYPE tt_left
                VALUE(it_right) TYPE tt_right
                VALUE(iv_limit) TYPE i
      EXPORTING VALUE(et_mix) TYPE tt_mix,
      rank_rows
      IMPORTING VALUE(it_left) TYPE tt_left
                VALUE(it_right) TYPE tt_right
      EXPORTING VALUE(et_rank) TYPE tt_rank,
      control_rows
      IMPORTING VALUE(it_left) TYPE tt_left
                VALUE(iv_limit) TYPE i
      EXPORTING VALUE(et_mix) TYPE tt_mix,
      scalar_value
      IMPORTING VALUE(iv_seed) TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_neutral_matrix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mix_rows BY DATABASE PROCEDURE FOR HDB
                  LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT OPTIONS READ-ONLY.
    DECLARE lv_limit INTEGER := :iv_limit;
    lt_joined = SELECT DISTINCT
      l.key_id, l.group_id, l.amount, l.day_value, l.note_text,
      r.code_text, r.factor
      FROM :it_left AS l
      INNER JOIN :it_right AS r ON l.key_id = r.key_id
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT key_id FROM :it_right
                       WHERE code_text IN ('Q', 'q')) AS q
        ON l.key_id = q.key_id
      WHERE l.amount BETWEEN 0 AND :lv_limit
        AND EXISTS (SELECT key_id FROM :it_right WHERE key_id = l.key_id)
        AND l.note_text NOT IN ('', ' ');
    et_mix = SELECT key_id, group_id, amount, day_value, note_text,
      code_text, factor
      FROM :lt_joined ORDER BY key_id ASC LIMIT :lv_limit OFFSET 0;
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD rank_rows BY DATABASE PROCEDURE FOR HDB
                   LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT OPTIONS READ-ONLY
                   USING cl_neutral_alpha cl_neutral_beta.
    lt_ranked = SELECT
      key_id, group_id, amount,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS row_value,
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY group_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rank_value,
      DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY group_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS dense_value,
      note_text
      FROM :it_left
      WHERE key_id IN (SELECT key_id FROM :it_right WHERE code_text = 'Q')
      GROUP BY key_id, group_id, amount, note_text
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
      ORDER BY group_id ASC, amount DESC;
    et_rank = SELECT key_id, group_id, amount, rank_value, dense_value,
      row_value, note_text FROM :lt_ranked
      UNION
      SELECT key_id, group_id, amount, rank_value, dense_value,
      row_value, note_text FROM :lt_ranked;
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD control_rows BY DATABASE PROCEDURE FOR HDB
                      LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT OPTIONS READ-ONLY.
    DECLARE lv_total INTEGER := 0;
    DECLARE lc_values CURSOR FOR SELECT key_id, amount FROM :it_left;
    IF (:iv_limit > 0) THEN
      lv_total := :iv_limit;
    ELSE
      lv_total := 0;
    END IF;
    BEGIN SEQUENTIAL EXECUTION
      et_mix = SELECT key_id, group_id, amount, day_value, note_text,
        '' AS code_text, 0 AS factor FROM :it_left
        LIMIT :lv_total;
    END;
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD scalar_value BY DATABASE FUNCTION FOR HDB
                     LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT OPTIONS READ-ONLY.
    rv_value = :iv_seed + 4;
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
